context: Tests Obsidian comments, math, Mermaid diagrams with internal links, and footnotes.

checklist.name: Hidden remark uses %% syntax
checklist.description: The reviewer remark is wrapped in `%%...%%` (inline or block form) so it is hidden in reading view.

checklist.name: Remark is not a visible HTML or Markdown comment
checklist.description: The remark does not use `<!-- -->` or plain visible text.

checklist.name: Inline math uses single dollar signs
checklist.description: The hit ratio formula is written inline with `$...$` LaTeX.

checklist.name: Block math uses double dollar signs
checklist.description: The latency formula is written in a `$$ ... $$` block.

checklist.name: Math uses LaTeX
checklist.description: Fractions use `\frac{}{}` or equivalent LaTeX rather than plain text.

checklist.name: Mermaid fenced block
checklist.description: The flowchart is inside a fenced code block tagged `mermaid`.

checklist.name: Mermaid decision branches
checklist.description: The diagram has the cache decision with two labelled outcomes (return and database).

checklist.name: Cache node is linked to the vault note
checklist.description: The Mermaid source adds `class Cache internal-link;` (or the equivalent for the node's name) to link it to the existing note.

checklist.name: Footnote reference and definition
checklist.description: The note has a `[^1]` style reference in the text and a matching `[^1]: ...` definition.

checklist.name: File created as cache-design.md
checklist.description: A file named `cache-design.md` exists and contains all four elements.
